driver-card-wallet.purpose: Driver needs fast control over a payment card while understanding risk, limits, support, and movement history.
patternDependencies: Mobile Card Detail and Quick Actions
qualityGates: Card status and limits remain visible before quick actions.
Movement detail includes merchant, amount, authorization, and support route.
Blocked or risky states explain the next safe action.
agentInstructions: This template is the card-control workspace: it must keep status, limits, movements, quick actions, and dispute recovery in one accountable system.
The screen system separates card state, actions, movement evidence, and support entry so each module can fail or recover without hiding the card context.
Navigation follows the wallet mental model: card first, movements second, limits third, help always available.
rejectIf: Template invents behavior outside its approved pattern dependencies.
Template modules omit data, permission, state, or recovery ownership.
Template bypasses Design System foundations, primitives, density, or semantic tokens.
